description: Grok Bot's desktop app through its cask.
why: Grok Bot also matches on the brew route, so must_find would pass with its bundle id broken; must_contain names com.anysphere.sand for that reason. Cursor is forbidden because Anysphere builds both apps, and Grok Build because both carry xAI's Grok name: neither may be read as Grok Bot, nor Grok Bot as either.
known_gaps: A match says the Grok Bot app is installed, not that a Bot ran or that a plan includes it.
Grok Bot is never launched, so no running-app value is read on macOS.
